task: Evaluate embeddings and Vectorize for evidence-bounded retrieval

freshness.policy: record immutable source revision and accessed-date distribution; do not infer freshness from similarity

criteria.name: corpus_size
criteria.observation: 2481 eligible atomic documents at the snapshot
criteria.consequence: pilot is technically feasible but scale does not mandate vectors

criteria.name: evidence_closure
criteria.observation: 1531 evidence records and zero audited missing references
criteria.consequence: retain D1 hydration and measure evidence locality

criteria.name: scope_metadata
criteria.observation: zero specified scope dimensions and zero evidence scope contexts
criteria.consequence: block scope-sensitive rollout and require unknown/abstention slices

criteria.name: claim_types
criteria.observation: features and views contain fact, inference, hypothesis, and analogy records
criteria.consequence: stratify claim discipline; similarity cannot upgrade claims

criteria.name: freshness
criteria.observation: 1527 of 1531 evidence records have accessed dates; source versions are heterogeneous
criteria.consequence: freeze and digest every experiment; define stale policy

criteria.name: privacy
criteria.observation: query text may be sensitive and provider policy is unselected
criteria.consequence: no external provider transfer before retention/training review

criteria.name: cost_latency
criteria.observation: lexical has no embedding/index cost and vector p50/p95 is unmeasured
criteria.consequence: require explicit budget and Worker-like latency evidence

criteria.name: explainability
criteria.observation: lexical overlap is inspectable while vector similarity is uncalibrated
criteria.consequence: show score kind, source, evidence, scope, and abstention

criteria.name: existing_metrics
criteria.observation: MTH-0134 defines discovery metrics but no populated lexical/vector comparison exists
criteria.consequence: no vector benefit claim until a valid gated manifest

options.rationale: Explainable, provider-neutral, low cost, and already preserves evidence-bounded D1 hydration.
Safest first test of representation value without production data egress.
Managed adapter is plausible only after model, privacy, cost, latency, and evaluation gates pass.
Provider retention, credentials, outage, and egress risks are currently unverified.
Model availability, dimensions, throughput, and request-path safety are unverified.
Compare complementarity only with explicit ablation and false-link gates.

entry_gates: freeze an immutable reviewed corpus and evidence bundle digest
validate local evidence closure and exclude drafts/private artifacts/held-out negatives
construct terminology, record-kind, claim-type, scope, freshness, and misleading-similarity query slices
obtain independent reviewer labels with disagreement retained
declare provider/model, representation, dimensions, metric, privacy, retention, and cost before vector run
acceptance_gates: macro nDCG@10 improves by at least 0.05 or paraphrase recall@10 improves by at least 0.10 versus lexical
evidence locality, scope completeness, and claim-type accuracy do not drop by more than 0.02 each
false-link rate does not rise by more than 0.02 overall or 0.05 in any claim-type stratum
held-out negative knowledge remains excluded and unknown/scope-mismatch abstention is explicit and no worse than lexical
p50/p95 latency, provider errors, storage/build cost, privacy, explainability, and rollback budgets are approved

trigger_conditions: missing evidence, draft/private metadata, or failed hydration
provider outage, budget breach, or privacy incident
failed evaluation/read smoke test or unexplained false-link increase

unresolved_questions: Which model meets language mix, privacy, retention, cost, and latency requirements?
Can reviewers label enough paraphrase and misleading-similarity queries with sparse scope metadata?
What freshness policy applies to missing accessed dates and historical commits?
Is a local experiment sufficient, or is disposable Vectorize latency evidence required?
Who owns publication, active-pointer auditing, and rollback?
